headline: Commission weighs director candidates, asks DPS about fraud screening

meeting.summary: The commission heard a recommendation to interview six candidates for personnel director and voted to ask DPS for input on fraud screening.
meeting.recap: The Civil Service Commission met Wednesday, August 5, 2026, starting at 9:15 a.m. after technical problems.[[0:00:35]] Commissioners approved the minutes of their July 1, 2026 meeting.[[0:02:24]] A commissioner presented a working group report on hiring a new personnel director.[[0:03:29]] The group received 17 applications.[[0:10:47]] The commission is expected to vote on the report at a special meeting planned for August 12.[[0:13:23]] The group recommends interviewing the top six candidates.[[0:16:03]] Interviews could be done in public by the full commission or in private by a new working group.[[0:23:47]] The commission met in executive session (a closed-door discussion) about candidate privacy.[[0:30:24]] A County Council committee asked the commission to comment on fraud risk findings about DPS, the county personnel department.[[0:32:45]] The fraud risk assessment found the county has no countywide nepotism policy, meaning rules on hiring relatives.[[0:34:50]] The commission voted to ask DPS for comments, costs, and a timeline for expanding fraud screening.[[0:44:56]] DPS is to respond by the commission's September meeting.[[0:46:05]] A report said ocean safety officers received an arbitration award for a four-year contract.[[0:47:41]] The commission voted to end its regular meeting and move into a separate session.[[0:51:52]]
decided: Commissioners approved the July 1, 2026 meeting minutes by voice vote.
The commission voted to go into executive session about candidate privacy and to consult its attorney.
The commission voted to adjourn its regular meeting and move into a separate session.
meeting.next: The review of state laws for the commission will be added to the next meeting agenda. No contact with candidates will happen until on or after the 12th. Corporation counsel will take added fire contract costs to the County Council for approval.

moments.q: Both reviewers scored on their own and picked the same top six
Two interview options: public full commission or private working group
Fraud risk assessment findings about DPS
Motion asking DPS to respond on fraud screening
